product_name: Apple 2023 MacBook Pro Laptop with Apple M2 Pro chip with 12‑core CPU and 19‑core GPU: 16.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR Display, 16GB Unified Memory, 512GB SSD Storage. Works with iPhone/iPad; Silver
review_text:
I upgraded from the $3,499 i9 Intel MacBook Pro from 2019, and this laptop seriously blows that away. The keyboard is amazing and so much better, the screen is amazing, I love the refresh rate, the responsiveness of jumping between pages and apps is so ridiculously fast, the trackpad and speakers are still just amazing, and the battery life on this is mind-blowing.


Seriously, 10/10, absolutely recommend this to anyone, this thing is insane. I put it in my backpack for 9 days, and 9 days later it was still at 54%, even though it was powered on the entire time. I literally got a FaceTime call on my iPhone and my MacBook rang in my backpack at the same time on day 9.


Get this MacBook if you need power and battery life, nothing will beat this.

product_name: Apple 2023 MacBook Pro Laptop with Apple M2 Pro chip with 12‑core CPU and 19‑core GPU: 16.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR Display, 16GB Unified Memory, 512GB SSD Storage. Works with iPhone/iPad; Silver
review_header: Shipped in an M1 Pro box
review_text: I had been considering this purchase for weeks by now. Eventually I bit the bullet and ordered this M2 pro Macbook pro. Unfortunately, however, when I opened the Amazon delivery box I saw the box for an M1 pro Macbook pro inside. At first, it was almost hard to recognize because of the muted colors / some of the colors on the box just not being where they should have been. Honestly, I have no idea what went wrong with this package, but it definitely wasn't what I was expecting. It sounds stupid, but this ruined the unboxing experience for me, as I was rushing through setup to try and see if this actually was an M1 or M2 computer (the chassis of the two are identical so it was impossible to tell). Thankfully it was an M2 pro, but this small error in packing caused me much unneeded stress. Additionally, this will lower the resale value of the computer in the future (if I decide to resell) as I am missing parts of the original package, *ahem* the M2 pro box itself. When it comes to the actual computer however, it’s perfect. Great screen, great performance, great speakers, the list goes on. And although the price of $2000 for a laptop seems a lot, I find it justifiable. You really do get what you pay for with this product. Expercom, if you ever see this review please reach out to me so I can get the box I paid for, and I will update my review to 5 stars because at the end of the day this really is a great machine.❤️

product_name: Apple iPhone 15 Plus FineWoven Case with MagSafe - Pacific Blue
review_header: Elegante, resistente y con gran agarre
review_text:
Esta funda de Apple de trenzado fino con MagSafe en color azul es simplemente excelente. El diseño es elegante y minimalista, con un acabado premium que se siente increíble al tacto. La textura del trenzado no solo le da un toque sofisticado y tiene un tacto suave muy agradable, sino que también mejora el agarre, evitando que el teléfono resbale fácilmente.


La compatibilidad con MagSafe es perfecta, permitiendo que los accesorios y cargadores magnéticos se acoplen sin problemas. Además, ofrece una protección sólida contra golpes y arañazos sin añadir volumen innecesario al dispositivo.


El color azul es muy bonito y tiene un tono moderno que combina bien con cualquier estilo. Después de semanas de uso, sigue viéndose impecable, sin marcas visibles ni desgaste.


Si buscas una funda de alta calidad que equilibre estilo, protección y funcionalidad, esta es una excelente elección. ¡Totalmente recomendada!
